message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/open62541 && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_binary_message.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":21,"var":"data,size","code":"if (!UA_memoryManager_setLimitFromLast4Bytes(data, size)) return 0; size -= 4;","note":"The attacker-controlled input is accepted and the last 4 bytes are reserved for the memory-limit trailer, leaving the remaining bytes as the crafted OPC UA message."},
{"step":2,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_binary_message.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":24,"var":"server","code":"UA_Server *server = UA_Server_new();","note":"A fresh server instance is created so the crafted message is processed by the vulnerable binary-message path."},
{"step":3,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_binary_message.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":39,"var":"msg","code":"retval = UA_ByteString_allocBuffer(&msg, size); memcpy(msg.data, data, size);","note":"The attacker bytes are copied verbatim into a mutable UA_ByteString that becomes the input to the parser."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/server/ua_server_binary.c","function":"UA_Server_processBinaryMessage","line":786,"var":"message","code":"UA_Connection_processChunks(connection, server, processCompleteChunk, message);","note":"The server hands the crafted byte string to the chunk processor, which routes complete chunks into the binary message decoder."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/server/ua_server_binary.c","function":"processCompleteChunkWithoutChannel","line":731,"var":"tcpMessageHeader","code":"UA_TcpMessageHeader_decodeBinary(message, &offset, &tcpMessageHeader);","note":"The first bytes are interpreted as an OPC UA TCP header, controlling which message-processing branch is taken."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/server/ua_server_binary.c","function":"processCompleteChunkWithoutChannel","line":739,"var":"message","code":"case UA_MESSAGETYPE_OPN: ... UA_AsymmetricAlgorithmSecurityHeader_decodeBinary(message, &messageHeaderOffset, &asymHeader);","note":"For an OPN chunk, the asymmetric security header is decoded from attacker data and the remaining payload is decrypted/forwarded into secure-channel processing."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/ua_securechannel.c","function":"UA_SecureChannel_processCompleteMessages","line":1368,"var":"chunk","code":"UA_SecureConversationMessageHeader_decodeBinary(chunk, &offset, &messageHeader);","note":"The secure-channel layer parses the secure conversation header and advances to the embedded service request payload."},
{"step":8,"file":"src/server/ua_server_binary.c","function":"processSecureChannelMessage","line":449,"var":"request","code":"UA_decodeBinary(msg, &offset, request, requestType, server->config.customDataTypes);","note":"The embedded request body is decoded according to the request type, reaching the generic binary type decoder on attacker-controlled bytes."},
{"step":9,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_binary.c","function":"Variant_decodeBinary","line":1098,"var":"encodingByte","code":"status ret = DECODE_DIRECT(&encodingByte, Byte);","note":"A crafted Variant encoding byte selects the variant content shape and can force the extension-object unwrap path."},
{"step":10,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_binary.c","function":"Variant_decodeBinaryUnwrapExtensionObject","line":1038,"var":"typeId,encoding","code":"status ret = DECODE_DIRECT(&typeId, NodeId); ret = DECODE_DIRECT(&encoding, Byte);","note":"The attacker controls the embedded type id and encoding byte, steering the decoder to treat the payload as an encoded ExtensionObject body."},
{"step":11,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_binary.c","function":"Variant_decodeBinaryUnwrapExtensionObject","line":1048,"var":"dst->type","code":"dst->type = UA_findDataTypeByBinaryInternal(&typeId, ctx); ctx->pos += 4;","note":"A matching binary type causes the decoder to skip the length field and decode the remaining bytes as the selected structured type."},
{"step":12,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_binary.c","function":"decodeBinaryStructure","line":1435,"var":"m,mt,ptr","code":"ret = decodeBinaryJumpTable[mt->typeKind]((void *UA_RESTRICT)ptr, mt, ctx);","note":"Structured members are decoded recursively from the attacker-controlled buffer, propagating lengths and nested fields into heap objects."},
{"step":13,"file":"src/pubsub/ua_pubsub_networkmessage.c","function":"UA_DataSetMessage_decodeBinary","line":1178,"var":"dst->data.deltaFrameData.fieldCount","code":"rv = UA_UInt16_decodeBinary(src, offset, &dst->data.deltaFrameData.fieldCount);","note":"The payload can declare an attacker-chosen delta-frame field count, which directly controls the size of the subsequent allocation."},
{"step":14,"file":"src/pubsub/ua_pubsub_networkmessage.c","function":"UA_DataSetMessage_decodeBinary","line":1183,"var":"memsize","code":"size_t memsize = sizeof(UA_DataSetMessage_DeltaFrameField) * dst->data.deltaFrameData.fieldCount;","note":"The field count is multiplied into a heap allocation size without a separate overflow check, creating the root cause for an undersized allocation when the count is extreme."},
{"step":15,"file":"src/pubsub/ua_pubsub_networkmessage.c","function":"UA_DataSetMessage_decodeBinary","line":1184,"var":"dst->data.deltaFrameData.deltaFrameFields","code":"dst->data.deltaFrameData.deltaFrameFields = (UA_DataSetMessage_DeltaFrameField*)UA_malloc(memsize);","note":"The undersized or otherwise attacker-influenced allocation is used as the destination array for per-field writes."},
{"step":16,"file":"src/pubsub/ua_pubsub_networkmessage.c","function":"UA_DataSetMessage_decodeBinary","line":1185,"var":"i","code":"for (UA_UInt16 i = 0; i < dst->data.deltaFrameData.fieldCount; i++) {","note":"The decoder iterates up to the attacker-controlled field count, so a large count drives writes past the allocated array bounds."},
{"step":17,"file":"src/pubsub/ua_pubsub_networkmessage.c","function":"UA_DataSetMessage_decodeBinary","line":1186,"var":"dst->data.deltaFrameData.deltaFrameFields[i].fieldIndex","code":"rv = UA_UInt16_decodeBinary(src, offset, &dst->data.deltaFrameData.deltaFrameFields[i].fieldIndex);","note":"Each loop iteration writes a field index into the allocated array; once the allocation is too small, this becomes the memory-safety sink."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
